list: the official 55 trophies, with a guide, kind, missable flag and roadmap stage for each

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat everything else in this guide as the checklist for this one: finish the story, close out the stranger strands while they are still open, clear the tracked grinds, and save the money-and-100% endgame for last.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; the full list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: play through the prologue and the trophy pops as the mission wraps up.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story trophies are unmissable, so this one arrives simply by playing the campaign through its first chapter.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Another unmissable story milestone. Around this part of the game the stranger strands start opening up, so check the map between chapters and begin them while their windows are wide open.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Unmissable. By now most activity types and the first stranger chains are available, which makes this a good moment to push the strand finales forward before later chapters close their windows.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Unmissable story progress — keep clearing stranger strands between missions, because the endgame chapters are where strand windows shut for good.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, sweep up any stranger strand you still need: the strand finales are the game's true missables, and the finale is the point of no return for open windows.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable as part of the campaign; it pops on the mission-complete screen.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. Unmissable; trophies tied to named missions always land as the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable campaign progress; it unlocks on the mission-complete screen.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable; play on through the campaign and it unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable. Remember the airport, VCIA — it comes back later for the Catch Me If You Can feat.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story progress, earned as the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; story list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion tracker. This is the long pole of the platinum: story, stranger strands, activities, challenges, collectibles and exploration all feed the percentage, so work the earlier roadmap stages first and use the in-game checklist to hunt down the last few percent.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; completion coverage in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — the jumps and stunt moves the game counts across Leonida. PSN tracks the total to 250, so check your running count here as you go; stunts found while exploring count immediately, and the grind is much shorter if you sweep them alongside the exploration trophy.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or even finish them — starting each type registers it. Work through the activity icons on the map (ranges, races, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest) and the trophy pops when the ninth type has been sampled.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; activity count as listed by PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA VI trophy coverage.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 challenges in all. Learn each range's target patterns and replay for the gold score line. The standard is per challenge rather than cumulative, so a silver anywhere is the one to revisit; clear the ranges in batches so the patterns stay fresh.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; challenge count as listed by PSNProfiles; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, and a win at each distinct course is required, so keep track of which ones are done. Drone handling is twitchy: bank a couple of practice runs on a new course before chasing the win.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; location count as listed by PSNProfiles; Push Square GTA VI trophy coverage.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not add to the count, so move around the race icons on the map and take a fresh event each time; the PSN counter on this card is your progress check.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's challenge, learn the reeling rhythm on a practice fish first, then out-catch him. Fishing challenges can be retried straight away, so this one is about persistence rather than a single perfect attempt.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; Push Square GTA VI trophy coverage.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any arcade cabinet counts: pick the shortest game on offer, finish a full play-through of it, and the trophy lands — no high score required.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; Push Square GTA VI trophy coverage.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Missable: Andy's chain only stays open for part of the story, so start his strand when it appears and finish the finale before pushing deep into the later chapters. Published missable coverage singles this chain out — do not leave it for the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; missable reporting in EGamers.io's GTA 6 trophy list and PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Missable for the same reason as the other strand finales: work Kenton's chain through to its end while it is on the map instead of banking it for after the story.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; missable reporting in EGamers.io's GTA 6 trophy list and PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Missable: finish Billy's chain before the story closes his window. If several strands are open at once, clear them in the order they appeared.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; missable reporting in EGamers.io's GTA 6 trophy list and PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain for one stranger, and the five named finales — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — count toward the eight, so finishing the missable chains first leaves only a few more strands to find.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; strand count as listed by PSNProfiles; EGamers.io GTA 6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Missable: Randy's window closes as the story advances, so run his chain when it surfaces and do not let the finale sit unfinished.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; missable reporting in EGamers.io's GTA 6 trophy list and PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Missable: as with the other four named strangers, finish the chain promptly — these five finales are exactly what a story-only playthrough loses.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; missable reporting in EGamers.io's GTA 6 trophy list and PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots. Flagged missable in published coverage because some spots sit in places the story changes as it goes, so meditate at each spot as you reach its area during the campaign instead of saving the whole set for a post-story sweep.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; spot count and missable reporting in EGamers.io's GTA 6 trophy list and PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Take the hunting request from Bret's strand, track the one-of-a-kind animal it names, and bring it down. It is a single scripted hunt rather than a species checklist, so follow the strand's own tracking prompts.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered all over Leonida, and a set only counts once every card in it is collected, so finish sets one at a time and use the collection screen to see exactly which cards a set still needs.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; collectible coverage in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. PSN tracks the count to 100; work new locations as you travel rather than repeating favourites, and sweep whatever is left during the exploration stage of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's rotating objective list and PSN tracks completions to 50, so keep one eye on the current challenges while you do everything else and the total builds naturally across the playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while you are with your partner, then lose the heat and escape without being caught. Commit crimes together until four stars, break the police line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars drain away — the trophy needs the escape, not just the stars.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without your wanted level dropping away in between. Plan a route of three nearby shops, rob them in one continuous run, and keep the heat alive between stores — letting it fully drain resets the chain.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you get into it for the first time, and traffic variety differs by district, so sample cars in new areas as you explore and the catalogue fills quickly.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up before you trigger it: pick a spot with a group of five or more enemies, activate Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A failed attempt costs nothing — reposition and retry on the next group.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, get out of the airport in a way the airport did not intend, such as taking an aircraft or a vehicle out without clearance. Head to VCIA, make your exit, and the trophy pops as you leave.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke at the player's expense: Rhinos are the game's tanks. Draw one out — at a high wanted level or wherever the military responds — and deal with the encounter: outlast it, disable it or escape it, and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms tripped, no witnesses raising the alert, and a clean exit. If you are spotted the attempt is void — leave, let things cool down, and try the same store again.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are the heavy end of the crime list: crack the vault, get out, and lose the heat. The escape is part of the requirement, so getting busted on the way out does not count.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida; stop one, crack it open, take the cash, and then lose the wanted level that follows before it escalates.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area registers as you enter it, and the map's area counter is your checklist. Most areas open up through normal play; the last few are usually outlying spots, best swept up during the collectibles stage.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; area count as listed by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. Each gang's operation counts once, so vary your targets instead of hitting the same gang twice, and keep a note of which gangs are already done.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; gang count as listed by PSNProfiles; GTABase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet-moment trophy: visit Ocean Beach, order the cocktail where drinks are served, and take in the view — a deliberate echo of where the series began.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into one of the showroom cars and drive it out through the glass — the trophy wants the dramatic exit, not the front door.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Any completed game at that specific alley counts — the location is the requirement, not your score — and it also registers bowling as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; Push Square GTA VI trophy coverage.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is deliberately vague, and published guides treat it as a hidden, story-adjacent moment for the partner duo. Play the campaign with both partners and it unlocks at its scripted moment; it is not a grind and there is nothing to farm for it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks this one to 500: it counts the choices you make as you play — dialogue picks, decisions and responses across the story and the strands. It builds over a full playthrough; if you are short near the end, strand and side content choices feed the same counter.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail an attempt at something the game lets you retry, then succeed at the same thing on the next attempt. Any repeatable test works — a race, a range challenge, a fishing challenge — as long as the success follows a failure of the same task.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd encounters in out-of-the-way places; explore off the beaten path — especially at night and away from the city — and when something inexplicable happens, stay and watch it play out.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: strike a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and the trophy pops when the hit connects — contact matters, not speed.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; hidden-trophy notes in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from scores and robberies; feed them to your laundering contacts until the cumulative total passes a quarter of a million. It is a money-endgame grind, so bank marked bills as they come in rather than spending them.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; money-trophy coverage in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, counted cumulatively. Every purchase adds to the total — vehicles, clothes, services — so it completes naturally in the endgame while you are buying garages and gear; there is no need to waste money on purpose.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; money-trophy coverage in PowerPyx's GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings around Leonida, and you need the cash first — which is why this sits in the money stage of the roadmap. Buy each one as funds allow.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; property count as listed by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app; ten registrations complete the trophy, and they can be ten ordinary cars — rarity is not required.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSN tracked count as shown by PSNProfiles.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story
roadmap.text: Work through the campaign: the opening mission Gone Fishing, Chapters 1 to 4, the named set-piece missions such as The Cartel Heist and VCIA Takedown, and the finale. All twelve story trophies are unmissable, and the story opens up the map, the activities and the stranger strands that everything else depends on.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Stranger strands before their windows close
roadmap.text: Start each stranger strand as it appears and finish the five named finales — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus Bret's hunt for Fair Game. These finales are the game's true missables, because story progress closes their windows. Meditate at meditation spots as you pass them, too: Positive Mental Attitude is flagged missable for the same reason.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Feats and robberies
roadmap.text: With the map open, take the crime list: shop and jewelry robberies, five bank vaults, an armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, and the partner wanted-level trophies. Add the one-off feats in the same pass — Combat Focus takedowns, the showroom exit, the unscheduled VCIA departure and the Rhino encounter.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — The tracked grinds
roadmap.text: Clear the counters PSN tracks: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 250 stunts, a Top Fun win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, every activity type sampled once, and 50 challenges. These reward steady progress, so chip away at them between the other stages rather than saving them all for the end.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 — Collectibles and the full map
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida: finish 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, meditate at any spots still left over, discover 100 vehicles and enter all 52 areas. The exploration trophies overlap heavily, so one methodical tour of the state pays several of them off at once.

roadmap.title: Stage 6 — Money, 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: Close out the economy: launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 across shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Then chase the last few percent of the completion tracker for A Long Road — and Vice Got a Price!, the platinum, follows automatically.
